title: Scan a JavaScript config for hardcoded secrets
prompt: Scan this JavaScript config file for hardcoded secrets and sensitive data. Redact them and give me a classified audit report.
intro: Found 2 critical findings: an AWS access key and a database connection string with embedded credentials. Both have been redacted in the output.

blocks.text: Scanned 6 lines via Strale secret scan. Provider returned 2 structured findings.

Remediation: Move the AWS key to an environment variable or AWS Secrets Manager. Rotate the key immediately. Replace the database URL with a secrets reference (e.g., Vault, AWS SSM). The Slack webhook and email were not detected by this provider.

limits: Live test with Strale secret scan on 2026-09-16. Provider detected 2 of 4 embedded secrets (AWS key, database URL). Slack webhook and email were not flagged — this may be a provider scope limitation. Payment was pending at capture (paid $0.00, held $0.0216).
